title: Spinach and Feta Pastilla
subtitle: with soft-boiled eggs and yoghurt
description: A round filo pie layered with wilted spinach, caramelised onion and feta, baked until golden and served with soft-boiled eggs and yoghurt.

steps.text: Blanch the spinach leaves in boiling water for about 30 seconds, then transfer to iced water for 5 minutes. Squeeze the leaves out well, chop and place in a bowl.
Heat the olive oil in a pan and fry the sliced onions, stirring, over low heat for about 20 minutes until caramelised.
Add the caramelised onion and crumbled feta to the spinach and mix well until even.
Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease a 26 cm round tin generously with olive oil.

Brush three or four filo sheets with olive oil and lay them overlapping in the tin so the base and sides are well covered and about a third of the sheets hang over the edge. Add a third of the filling and press down lightly. Repeat twice more (the filo then only separates the layers) and finish with a top layer of three oiled sheets. Brush the top well with oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until golden. Remove, cool at room temperature for half an hour, slice and serve with soft-boiled eggs and yoghurt.
